name: @playhall/ops-sweep
description: Behaviour tests for scripts/ops/stranded-issue-sweep.mjs, the company-side net for issues with no wake path. The cases are pinned to the recorded pre-restart state of the eight issues that died in the 2026-09-29 20:07-20:09Z batch harness failure (PER-151), so the sweep is proven against the batch it exists to have caught rather than against hand-written shapes.
